board.title: File tracker
board.prose:
A small app that keeps track of where my files are. A file is either on the laptop, ready to open, or only in cloud storage. Bringing one back needs enough free space, and the app says how much is missing when there isn't.

This is the example from the README: **v1** is the first shape, **v2** adds filtering.

nodes.prose:
The first screen: every file I've touched recently, newest first. Search filters the list in place, matching names and folders.

Tapping a file opens its page, which says where the file is right now.
